metadata.description: The bill to grant Scheduled Tribe (ST) status to the Hatti community of the Trans Giri area in Himachal Pradesh was passed in the Rajya Sabha. This parliamentary approval marks a major milestone for the Hatti community, as they have been advocating for ST status for the past five decades. With the passage of the bill in the Rajya Sabha, the Hatti community will now officially be recognized as a Scheduled Tribe, entitling them to various constitutional rights, benefits, and government support aimed at improving their social and economic conditions.
